name: ContainerNetwork-AutoFix
description: ContainerNetwork AutoFix (CNAF) - Automatically recreates Docker containers that depend on a master container's network when the master container restarts. Perfect for containers routing through VPN containers like GluetunVPN. When a master container (e.g., VPN) restarts and gets a new container ID, dependent containers using --net=container: lose network connectivity. CNAF automatically detects and recreates those dependent containers. Features: - Auto-detects dependent containers - Preserves container states (running/stopped) - Smart waiting for VPN establishment - Automatic log rotation - Zero manual configuration needed

variables.name: Master Container Name
variables.description: Select your VPN/master container from the dropdown. For custom container names, click EDIT and enter the name in the Value field.

variables.name: Restart Wait Time
variables.description: Seconds to wait after master container restarts before recreating dependents (allows VPN to establish)

variables.name: Max Log Lines
variables.description: Maximum number of log lines to keep (automatic rotation)

variables.name: Max Retries
variables.description: Number of times to retry finding master container on startup

variables.name: Retry Delay
variables.description: Seconds between retry attempts when finding master container
